anomalies.observed: D2 (LED) anode is on the HEATER net and its cathode is on Net-(D2-K), which connects only to C14 (22uF) to GND. There is no series current-limiting resistor; the LED is in series with a 22uF capacitor to ground.
anomalies.expected: The spec states a status LED D2 with a series resistor R3 on the HEATER net: 'A status LED (D2) and series resistor (R3) are also on the HEATER net'. A series resistor (R3) should be present to limit LED current; a capacitor in that position is not a valid indicator circuit.

evidence.quote: A status LED (D2) and series resistor (R3) are also on the HEATER net, so the heater output doubles as a visual 'heater on' indicator at the board level

anomalies.impact: The heater-on indicator LED will not light continuously when the heater is on; instead it will only flash briefly while C14 charges, so the visual heater-on indication is effectively lost.

parsed.summary: The design largely matches the specification, but the heater status LED D2 is wired with a 22uF capacitor (C14) to ground in place of the specified series resistor R3, so the LED indicator will not function as intended.
